additionalTables.purpose: A link from a skill or role revision to a lesson (a Knowledge claim) it came from follows both of its ends. It is deleted with its project when either end is the project's: the revision belongs to a project skill or is a draft confined to the project (schema49 instructions and instruction_revisions), or the lesson is a claim of the project (knowledge_claims.project_id). Deleting a project's lesson deletes the link even when the revision is a workspace one and stays; deleting a project's skill revision deletes the link even when the lesson is general and stays. Every other link is never a candidate.
